target_customer: Healthcare marketing teams at hospitals, payers, pharmacies, dental and specialty providers, and pharma
problem: Modern analytics and ad tools can leak HIPAA regulated patient data; Freshpaint controls what data flows to third party marketing tools while still enabling measurement.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription (earlier a free tier was launched in 2022)
product_category: Healthcare customer data platform and privacy compliance

founders.name: Steven Fitzsimmons
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder with no background.

founders.name: Michael Malis
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page he joined Heap after high school in 2015, scaled a roughly petabyte Postgres cluster and led the database team; no college listed.

competitors.name: Segment
competitors.what: Customer data platform that routes event data to analytics and marketing tools; Freshpaint positioned as a no-code, retroactive alternative

technical_complexity.rationale: Autocapturing events and routing data to many tools, then later controlling HIPAA regulated flows, is standard data infrastructure with hard compliance parts.

defensibility.rationale: Signing a BAA and deep integrations with healthcare ad and analytics stacks are harder to copy than a generic CDP, which Segment lacked at the time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied the healthcare wedge in the sources found; no acquisition of Freshpaint was reported.

market_need_then: Teams paid for Segment style tooling but needed engineers to maintain it; Freshpaint's early pitch was no-code event collection. Healthcare privacy demand grew later, shown by 2024 STAT coverage of health data law compliance.

branding.domain_note: Uses freshpaint.io; legal entity Perfalytics, Inc.

identity.logo: Wordmark and logo shown on YC page, not described in detail
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and compliance focused: healthcare marketing without privacy risk

brand_strength.rationale: Brand search returned nothing about Freshpaint itself; the name suggests a design tool and had no press coverage as a brand.

pivots.from: No-code customer data collection as a Segment alternative for general startups
pivots.to: HIPAA safe data collection and marketing platform for healthcare
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; the pivot is inferred from early Segment comparison content versus the current healthcare positioning

outcome_analysis: Freshpaint raised a small seed after YC, a Series A of about 9.5M plus debt in November 2022, and a 30M Series B in July 2024, and describes itself as growing toward 120 people. Its focus moved from a general no-code Segment alternative to HIPAA safe data flows for healthcare, where a business associate agreement and health data enforcement created a wedge generic tools lacked. No exit, shutdown or layoffs were found.
notes: Series B is reported as 30M by the company and 30.7M by HIT Consultant and Intel Capital. Totals conflict: CEO says 42M, CB Insights 47.35M, ZoomInfo 45.2M, PitchBook 41.8M. Seed 1.65M appears on Seedtable and Startupintros with dates 2020-04 and 2020-08. PitchBook lists a 150K accelerator round in January 2019, unverified. One outlet says the 2022 round was 10M led by Insight Partners; Intel Capital's own release says Series A led by Intel Capital, so the Insight claim is treated as unverified. The Business Wire release returned 403. Segment source is a 2020 company blog, a few months after the batch.
